name: box-fort-banditz
description: Box Fort Banditz - chaotic 3D browser multiplayer party game set in Trashington

scripts.dev: npm run dev --workspace server & npm run dev --workspace client
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace client && npm run build --workspace server
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace shared && npm run test --workspace client
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p shared && tsc -p server --noEmit && tsc -p client --noEmit
